newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Final Russian Duma vote rejects anti-Yeltsin resolution.
newsitem.headline: Final Russian Duma vote rejects anti-Yeltsin resolution.

text.p: The State Duma lower house of the Russian parliament, in a second vote, reversed its earlier decision and rejected a motion on Wednesday that had aimed to force President Boris Yeltsin out of office on health grounds.
Deputies, who just minutes earlier had voted 229 to 63 for the motion "in principle", then rejected a "definitive vote" on the same resolution by 102 to 87 with five abstentions.
The session rose after the second vote leaving the move against Yeltsin apparently at an end.
Many government supporters in the opposition-dominated 450-seat lower chamber had boycotted the debate, which had been demanded by communist deputies.

The Duma's own legal committee had earlier ruled that the resolution had no legal force. The motion said Yeltsin's term should be declared over because he was too sick to rule and called for new presidential elections.
